title: Who will top the PSA women's world squash rankings on September 21, 2026?
background: The Professional Squash Association (PSA) publishes weekly world rankings for professional squash players.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official PSA women's world rankings dated September 21, 2026. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the player ranked first in that rankings update. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
